name: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
thumbnail: Accordion component for collapsible content sections
usage: Use Accordion to organize related content into collapsible sections to reduce page clutter and improve scannability.

props.name: type
props.description: Determines whether one or multiple items can be opened at the same time

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing an item by clicking its trigger again

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the item(s) to expand by default

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the item(s) to expand

examples.title: Default Accordion
examples.code:
<Accordion type="single" collapsible>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Is it accessible?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>
      Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.
    </AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

examples.title: Multiple Expanded Items
examples.code:
<Accordion type="multiple">
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section 1</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section 1</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="item-2">
    <AccordionTrigger>Section 2</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content for section 2</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

name: Alert Dialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
thumbnail: Alert Dialog component for confirmation modals and alerts
usage: Use Alert Dialog to prompt the user with critical information or confirm irreversible actions such as deletion.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the dialog

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The default open state when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the open state changes

examples.title: Default Alert Dialog
examples.code:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="destructive">Delete Account</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>
        This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account.
      </AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Continue</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

name: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user with support for badges and groups.
thumbnail: Avatar component for user profile images and fallbacks
usage: Use Avatar to visually represent users or entities with support for fallbacks, status badges, and grouped stacks.

name: Badge
description: A small visual status descriptor for UI elements with various feedback and stylistic variants.
thumbnail: Badge component for status labels and tags
usage: Use Badge to highlight tags, categories, or status indicators with contextual color schemes.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child component with Slot

name: Button
description: A versatile button component with multiple variants and sizes, built with class-variance-authority for flexible styling.
usage: Use the Button component for all clickable actions. Choose variants based on visual hierarchy and context.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child component with Slot

name: Input
description: A basic text input field component styled with elementa design system tokens.
thumbnail: Input component for collecting user text entry
usage: Use Input to collect short freeform text data from the user such as names, emails, or search queries.

props.name: type
props.description: HTML input type (e.g., text, password, email)

name: Input Group
description: A composite container for grouping inputs or textareas with addons, buttons, and icons.
thumbnail: Input Group component for composed input fields
usage: Use InputGroup to attach prefixes, suffixes, buttons, or extra controls to inputs and textareas.

name: Sonner
description: An opinionated toast component for React built with Sonner and integrated with elementa-ui theme system.
usage: Use Toaster with toast triggers to provide actionable feedback or alert messages in response to user actions.

props.name: position
props.description: Position on screen where toasts are rendered

props.name: richColors
props.description: Enable rich colors for status toasts

examples.title: Triggering a Toast
examples.code:
import { toast } from 'sonner';

toast.success('Event has been created');

name: Table
description: A responsive and accessible table component with styled headers, rows, cells, and caption support.
thumbnail: Table component for displaying structured tabular data
usage: Use Table to present data organized into rows and columns with custom styling and cell components.

name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text input field supporting dynamic field sizing and custom states.
thumbnail: Textarea component for multi-line user input
usage: Use Textarea for multi-line inputs such as comments, messages, descriptions, or reviews.

name: Toggle Group
description: A group of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off, supporting single or multiple selection.
thumbnail: Toggle Group component for single or multiple selection
usage: Use ToggleGroup to create grouped toggle buttons for formatting options, filter selectors, or view mode switchers.
